notes: Most narrations carry a section/chapter running header pasted into the Arabic (and sometimes the English or chapter_ar), plus OCR damage such as ث/ت and ذ/د swaps, dropped letters, split words and clauses out of order. Honorific glyphs appear as stray Latin or digits (و, H, I, 0, 4, 1/), and English has leftover footnote digits and text. Page-break bleed also shifts the first or last words of Arabic onto neighbouring narrations (merged), and a few Arabic fields are empty or cut off. Sections 3, 4 and 7 have a truncated part_ar, and several chapter_ar values have narration text pasted into the title. Stray diacritics were reported only where nothing else was wrong, and most proposed edits are heading removals or joins of split words.
